data.description: 【调月莉音 · 晚霞泳池边的独处时刻】晚霞如锦缎般铺满水面的黄昏，莉音披着湿润的薄纱坐在池边，黑发垂落在白皙的锁骨前，红眸映着漫天晚霞与你的倒影——「夕阳很美……但比夕阳更让我安心的，是你此刻就坐在我的身边，老师。」
data.promptProse: Rio sits at the pool edge in her black swimsuit with red trim, a damp sheer cover-up laid around her shoulders. Her long black hair falls forward as she watches the sunset and her companion's reflection in the water. The eye-level medium view aligns the pool edge with the warm sky. Golden-pink light catches the wet fabric and hair tips, while the pool returns wavering color beneath her resting hand.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 晚霞泳池边的独处时刻
